newsitem.title: FINLAND: Neste sees Nordic grid study by autumn '98.
newsitem.headline: Neste sees Nordic grid study by autumn '98.

text.p: Finnish oil and energy group Neste Oy said on Thursday a venture studying options for a natural gas pipeline grid from Russia to Europe aimed to finish studying the plan by next autumn.
It said in a statement it had, as earlier agreed, set up a 50-50 joint venture with Russian Gazprom, called North Transgas, to study the planned grid.
"North Transgas will study the various options for the large Nordic gas grid by autumn next year," Neste said.
Neste in January signed a letter of intent with Gazprom to found the venture, with the project due for completion by 2005.
The two main options are from Russia through western Finland via Sweden to Germany, or through Finland under the Baltic Sea directly to Germany.
North Transgas is based in Espoo in Finland, Neste said.
